content: The best friend is the man who in wishing me well wishes it for my sake alone.
author: Aristotle
story:
Studying for two decades in Plato's Academy before tutoring Alexander the Great and founding the Lyceum in Athens, Aristotle systematically mapped human knowledge. Observing nature and human societies, he concluded that human happiness (Eudaimonia) is not a passive state or fleeting pleasure, but an active, lifelong practice of excellence and virtue balanced along the golden mean.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Aristotle saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your life needs your unconditional support or appreciation today without any transaction?
